decision: The pair does not show meaningful overall benefit sufficient to justify the additional persistent index and write/HOT costs. Leave the exact eight-file candidate reverted; retain its source and diagnostic evidence.
functionalScope: Both runs pass the same small workload:1000 nodes/edges,1000 ID reads,100 key reads,200 committed singles, five changed-group repeats each at1/100/1000, reopened readback and cleanup. Both reports retain performanceQualification=not_evaluated and unchanged10000ms/30000ms limits.

sourceState.explanation: The benchmark dirty flag uses git status --porcelain, including untracked paths. Current status contains only unrelated untracked caches/build/evidence paths; no staged or unstaged tracked changes remain. The baseline manifest and all eight restored paths match HEAD.

limits: These are sequential independent fixtures, not randomized replicated trials; do not claim a causal regression or prove the index is universally useless.

The approximately0.29% lower changed1000 median is within broad overlapping repeat ranges; create-inclusive, edge-inclusive and changed100 medians are worse in this pair. No material net benefit is demonstrated.
Inclusive creation/edge load timings include their documented surrounding work; edge-inclusive is not merely the sum of timed apply and commit.
Candidate actual1024 previously failed with57014 before commit; the full-small pass does not replace that gate. Keep the1024 and release-performance blocker open.
No new diagnostic variants or blind retries are recommended for this index candidate.
